visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man sitting on a long wooden bench positioned under the shade of a leafy tree. He is wearing a white sleeveless ribbed shirt, green trousers, and light-colored sandals. He holds a coffee cup, taking a sip while looking forward. To his left sits an open white pizza-style box and a black backpack. The background consists of a white heritage building with distinctive arched window frames. (2) The man puts his drink down and leans forward to grab a large white sheet of paper resting on his lap. He looks directly into the camera with a calm expression. The lighting is bright natural daylight, highlighting the textures of the building's facade and the foliage of the tree. (3) He lifts the white paper completely to cover his face and torso. Large black text is printed on the paper. The camera remains static throughout the shot, capturing the full body of the man and the surrounding street environment.
